node.statement: Vocabulary match: by def-stochastic and def-almost-idempotent, a row-stochastic matrix Q is the same object as the row-stochastic map Q:l_inf^n->l_inf^n used in lem-routef-f0-assembly, a stochastic idempotent means row-stochastic E with E^2=E, and ||.||_{inf->inf} is the same induced operator norm denoted ||.||_{infinity->infinity}; independent of n is exactly n-free. Hence the external conclusion has precisely the hypotheses and conclusion of node 1.
